message.abyssalascentcore.discordnotice:
%s Join the Abyssal Ascent Discord: %s
Please check #known-bugs before creating a ticket or asking about bugs in #general.
message.abyssalascentcore.structurepos: %s There has been an update to Abyssal Ascent since you last played, there is now a structure at [X : %s, Y : %s, Z: %s] where world spawn is located
message.abyssalascentcore.gc_hint: %s If you are experiencing stuttering with Distant Horizons enabled, switching to the ZGC garbage collector can improve stability.
message.abyssalascentcore.bug_report: Abyssal Ascent Core is currently under development. It may occur that bugs interrupt your playthrough which is why we need your help to patch them. To report a bug, state the bug and ping @cobster in the discord server (found by doing /aa discord)
message.abyssalascentcore.summons_target: You can change this again in %s second(s)
message.abyssalascentcore.summons_called: %s of your summons stopped attacking a player
message.abyssalascentcore.summons_can_at: Your summons can attack other players, to disable this type /aa summons_target ignore_players
message.abyssalascentcore.summon_protect: This summon can't attack you, so you can't attack it
message.abyssalascentcore.help.locator: /aa locator <team|global> <disable|dot-only|enable> - what you share on the depth bar, with your team or everyone else
message.abyssalascentcore.help.locator_q: /aa locator query - shows your locator settings
message.abyssalascentcore.help.summons_t: /aa summons_target [all_players|opponents|ignore_players] - which players your summons may target
message.abyssalascentcore.help.bug_repor: /aa bug_report - how to report a bug
message.abyssalascentcore.help.reload_ru: /aa debug reload_rules - reloads the mining rules (operators)
message.abyssalascentcore.help.tunnel: /aa debug tunnel [radius] - clears a shaft through every dimension of the stack (operators)
